quotes.text: What we need is something better, and that’s what we’re calling “human at the helm.” First, you should be able to set parameters in advance
Second, the system should escalate something when it requires judgment or goes outside those parameters.
Third, you want a system that increases what you’re capable of at work, extending your agency, creativity and judgment.
And yes, simply having a human in the loop can create false confidence.
Today, “human in the loop” is widely understood to mean AI drafts something and you approve it or hit send.
